blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Here is INQToday’s top stories this afternoon. Super Typhoon Rosal maintains its strength as several areas remain under Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No. 1 and 2, prompting residents to stay alert for possible severe weather conditions. Meanwhile, an OCTA Research survey shows that most Filipinos want to see evidence against Vice President Sara Duterte in her ongoing impeachment trial. And Sen. Panfilo Lacson says the Supreme Court ruling on the 2024 and 2025 national budgets shows that the General Appropriations Acts for those years were the worst in Philippine history./dp READ: Pagasa raises Signal No. 2 in Batanes […]...
